description: Defines the QuicFlowController class and interface for managing flow control in QUIC streams and connections, including methods for updating offsets, sending window updates, and auto-tuning receive windows.

classes.name: QuicFlowControllerInterface
classes.description: Interface for flow control operations, ensuring minimum window size.

classes.name: QuicFlowController
classes.description: Implements flow control for a QUIC stream or connection, managing byte offsets, window sizes, and flow control frames.

methods.name: EnsureWindowAtLeast
methods.description: Ensures the flow control window is at least a specified size.

methods.name: UpdateHighestReceivedOffset
methods.description: Updates the highest received byte offset from the peer.

methods.name: AddBytesConsumed
methods.description: Increments the count of bytes consumed locally.

methods.name: AddBytesSent
methods.description: Increments the count of bytes sent to the peer.

methods.name: UpdateSendWindowOffset
methods.description: Updates the send window offset and returns whether the flow control state changed.

methods.name: SendWindowUpdate
methods.description: Sends a window update frame to the peer.

methods.name: FlowControlViolation
methods.description: Checks if flow control limits have been violated by the peer.

methods.name: MaybeSendBlocked
methods.description: Sends a BLOCKED frame if flow control limits are reached.

methods.name: UpdateReceiveWindowSize
methods.description: Updates the size of the receive window.

methods.name: MaybeSendWindowUpdate
methods.description: Sends a window update if appropriate.

methods.name: MaybeIncreaseMaxWindowSize
methods.description: Auto-tunes the maximum receive window size.

methods.name: UpdateReceiveWindowOffsetAndSendWindowUpdate
methods.description: Updates the receive window offset and sends a window update.

methods.name: IncreaseWindowSize
methods.description: Doubles the receive window size up to a maximum.
